title: Checkpoint
description: Written at every node boundary, in the same transactional batch as the node's terminal status (ADR-0008 §10). Intra-agent iteration checkpoints are explicitly out of scope: an agent attempt is the unit of retry, and a partially completed agent loop is re-run, not resumed.

schemaVersion.description: ADR-0024 §5: stored documents are versioned as data. One version exists in V1.

workspaceState.description: The load-bearing invariant of ADR-0003 §6: workspace state is at all times a function of (repoRef, baseSHA, ordered patch series), all of which live in durable state. This is simultaneously what makes resume work and what makes a remote executor a drop-in. Without it, workspaces become precious mutable state on one laptop and both properties are lost.

patchSeries.description: Ordered. Applying these to baseSha reproduces the working tree exactly.
